technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochastic bullish cross and supertrend support present reversal potential, but weak trend structure, negative money flow, price below all key moving averages, and lack of volume confirmation make this a low-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: KMI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 22 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional purchases are modest and dated (69+ days old), providing weak confirmation; no recent news sentiment available to validate setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (335.2) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures energy multinationals, and earnings in 22 days adds binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9), stochastic bullish cross, and supertrend support with price near 13.17 support level create technical reversal setup in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, negative money flow, weak trend structure (ADX 24.59), macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, DXY headwind), earnings binary event in 22 days, and zero institutional/insider conviction make this a low-probability trap setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical oversold conditions (RSI 9, stochastic cross) present reversal potential at support, but macro environment and earnings binary event within 22 days create unacceptable risk-reward asymmetry for swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 22 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and price below all major moving averages creates high probability of gap move against position.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 3 positions open in Energy sector; adding KMI increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress.
